name: Darrehof
beschreibung: The Darrehof is a hotel created from a historic farmhouse in the Tiroler Alpine region. Its location on the edge of the village affords an unobstructed view of the mountain range and direct access to hiking trails. The rooms are furnished with wooden furniture and equipped with modern amenities. The wellness area includes a sauna and a steam bath. Half board offers regional dishes in a rustic dining room. The quiet atmosphere, geared toward slowing down, appeals especially to nature lovers and those seeking peace and quiet. The farm operation is family-run and values personal contact.
